query: Krea2 Turbo int8_convrot UNet on RX 9070 XT (gfx1201, ROCm 7.2) samples cleanly but decodes to black/NaN; fp8_scaled works; suspected quantized-kernel defect on ROCm.

desired.outcome: LukeG89 (C0) points to the --enable-triton-backend arg (per #14782). JoaoZaokk (C1) shows the text-encoder 'works' half is a false positive (TEs always dequantize to fp32) so the diffusion-path NaN is the real bug; no confirmed fix.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
